customManagers.description: The test dependencies tests/run.lua clones at pinned commits. The comment above each entry names the datasource: git-tags follows releases, git-refs a branch's newest commit.

packageRules.description: Automerge digest, pin, patch and minor updates once CI passes: the mise pins (neovim, the github:SpechtLabs/sigil release the end-to-end tests run against, the linters), the oldest Neovim in ci.yaml, the test dependencies in tests/run.lua and the actions. Majors wait for a person.
ci.yaml's oldest Neovim stays in the oldest supported series; raising the series drops support and is done by hand.
The test dependencies move weekly and together; nvim-treesitter's main branch gets several commits a day.
mise is pinned as MISE_VERSION in every workflow; move them at once.
